rationale: 120s is conservative admission versus approximately 6s prior official-reference runs, with added tail arithmetic, source hashing and publication. It is not an execution-time estimate and is not copied from a failed DUT run. Process-tree RSS is sampled and kill-enforced, not an OS memory cap. Disk is statically admitted and sampled, not a filesystem quota. Production worker prohibits Python-level process creation; wrapper cleans its group and discovered/adopted descendants. A malicious native double-fork between samples is outside this trusted worker contract.
